== Memories of Light ==

Hello. I just wanted to clarify a few things regarding the Memories of Light. We haven't had anyone start posting them, but I'd like to do some preemptive footwork. On Tor's [http://www.tor.com/memories-of-light/register registration page], they have wording such as "e-mail only previews" and "must sign up for the email list ... to receive the daily Memories of Light." To me, this means that they should not be posted on a public forum, such as this wiki. I understand this and I would fully support this, unless we get word from you or Tor indicating anything different. My question would be can we post these after ''A Memory of Light'' comes out in January? I would think that we would be able, but I wanted to make sure. Thanks in advance for any assistance. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 06:17, November 30, 2012 (UTC)
